answer: Vesting delays make sybil farms slow and costly. New rewards sit locked for several epochs, like a pearl the harbor keeps until the ship proves it will stay. If an identity is caught as part of a cloned cluster during that window, its locked balance is burned. An attacker running 500 fake agents must keep each one honest for weeks, paying compute every epoch, while one bad attestation can wipe the whole vault. The ivory tower of instant payouts is what sybils need; delay removes it.
